parameters.query: SELECT latest_html FROM sessions WHERE session_id = '{{$json["body"]["session_id"]}}';

INSERT INTO sessions (session_id, latest_html, last_prompt, updated_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.session_id }}',
  '{{ $json.html.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{$('Webhook').item.json["body"]["prompt"].replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (session_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  latest_html = EXCLUDED.latest_html,
  last_prompt = EXCLUDED.last_prompt,
  updated_at = NOW();
